# AIA Detroit

> > The Detroit chapter of the American Institute of Architects, serving Michigan's architecture community with news, leadership development, advocacy, and professional resources.

AIA Detroit represents architects and design professionals across Metro Detroit and Michigan, promoting design excellence, equity in architecture, and professional development. The chapter provides industry updates, leadership programs like the Christopher Kelley Leadership Development initiative, and connects members with national AIA resources and local community initiatives.

## Key Topics

- AIA Detroit
- American Institute of Architects
- Detroit architecture
- Michigan architects
- Design equity and inclusion
- Architecture Billings Index (ABI)
- Leadership development
- Board elections and governance
- COVID-19 industry response
- Social justice in architecture
- NOMA (National Organization of Minority Architects)
- Committee on the Environment (COTE)
- Fellows honors and recognition
- Construction industry updates
- Professional licensing and regulation
